paper.title: Virulence and antibiotic-resistance genes in Enterococcus faecalis associated with streptococcosis disease in fish

key_claims.C1_virulence_total: 69 virulence genes across the three strains; core VFs (tpx, perR, psr, gelE) in all three; hylB only in BFFF11; agg+prgB absent in BFF1B1 & BFPS6
key_claims.C2_amr_total: 39 AMR genes across 16 antibiotic groups; 35 conserved in all three; tet(M/L/S/45) only in BFPS6
key_claims.C3_tetracycline_BFPS6: Tetracycline resistance genes tet(M), tet(L), tet(S), tet(45) found ONLY in BFPS6
key_claims.C4_bacteriocin: Bacteriocin synthesis gene clusters (antiSMASH) in BFFF11 and BFPS6, not BFF1B1; NRPS also in BFFF11
key_claims.C5_phylogeny: BF1B1 and BFFF11 cluster together (tilapia); BFPS6 forms separate branch closer to human strain
key_claims.C7_plasmid: PlasmidFinder replicons; used V583 (AE016830) as BRIG reference
